subject: Arch9 plane word7 fixed; full 32-byte v9 parity; 777 checks
body: New finding accepted: n2t Generic/ASTC plane word7 is v10-only. n2t_pack_layout and n2t_plane_pack now write word7=0 for shared arch9/v2 payloads; old qualified n2r gd_texture bytes are untouched. Tests switched to pinned genxml/v9_pack.h for all 32 plane bytes (Generic+ASTC), and the n2r regression asserts old words0..6 equal, v2 word7=0, legacy word7 nonzero. Helper 777 checks PASS release+ASan/UBSan; n2r suite eight lines PASS release+ASan including oversized binding_count. STATUS updated. Remaining bridge D2_OFFSET/whole-BO span, swizzle_valid, view-format sampler, fixed/compositor sampler guards are other owners. No phone/build/commit/publish.
